definitions.explanation: Childish word for urine or the act of urinating. Universally understood and commonly used with children, but also used casually by adults.

examples.japanese: おしっこ{行|い}ってくる。
{子供|こども}がおしっこを{漏|も}らしてしまった。

notes:
REGISTER: Childish but socially acceptable. Commonly used when speaking to or about children, and casually among adults in informal settings.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- おしっこする (to pee)
- おしっこに{行|い}く (to go pee)
- おしっこを{漏|も}らす (to wet oneself)

ALTERNATIVES: More formal terms include {小便|しょうべん} (crude/direct) and {尿|にょう} (medical). Polite expressions include お{手洗|てあら}いに{行|い}く (to go to the restroom).
